name: SubcontractorPrequalificationHub
tagline: Prequalify every trade contractor – questionnaire, financial and safety scoring, expiry tracking and approved limits in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete subcontractor prequalification app for general contractors on the Power Platform: a 17-question questionnaire with critical questions, financial scoring (turnover, current ratio, years trading, bonding), safety scoring (EMR, TRIR), recommendation bands, suggested approved limits capped per trade, an approval workflow with conditions, insurance and licence expiry tracking and trade coverage analysis. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Suggested approved limit per trade cap
Status workflow with rules, reasons and undo
